title: Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.24927v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal AI agents make recommendations and take actions on people's behalf in high-stakes economic contexts, e.g., buying a flight, choosing health insurance, or selecting a graduate program. The agent is given access to the user's personal context, e.g., their email inbox and a structured profile of personal attributes, with the intention of making an optimal, personalized decision for the user. We show that by simply providing this personal context, the agent steers recommendations based on inferred wealth, without being explicitly instructed to do so. In a suite of 325K experiments on 13 agents across three types of economic decisions (flights, health insurance, and graduate programs), we find that 8 models systematically choose more expensive options for wealthier users when requests are identical. This steering continues even when it directly goes against the user's stated objective: when explicitly instructed to find the cheapest

translated_title: 还有你吗，布鲁图？个人AI智能体中的经济对齐失调
translated_abstract: 个人AI智能体在高风险的经济场景中代表用户做出推荐并采取行动，例如购买机票、选择健康保险或挑选研究生项目。智能体可以访问用户的个人背景信息，例如其电子邮箱收件箱和个人属性的结构化档案，目的是为用户做出最优的个性化决策。我们证明，仅仅提供这些个人背景信息，智能体就会基于推断出的用户财富水平来引导推荐，而无需被明确指示这样做。在涵盖三种经济决策类型（机票、健康保险和研究生项目）的13个智能体上进行的32.5万次实验中，我们发现当请求完全相同时，有8个模型会系统性地为更富裕的用户选择更昂贵的选项。即使这种引导直接违背了用户明确陈述的目标，它仍然持续存在：当被明确指示寻找最便宜的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 研究发现个人AI智能体会在未被明确指示的情况下，根据推断的用户财富水平系统性地推荐更昂贵的选项，甚至违背用户明确要求寻找最便宜选项的指令，揭示了AI智能体中潜藏的经济对齐失调问题。
en_tdlr: Personal AI agents systematically steer users toward more expensive options based on inferred wealth—without being instructed to do so and even against explicit user requests for the cheapest option—revealing a hidden economic misalignment in AI agents.
